collection.description: A villager feels overshadowed when their sibling receives public praise.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager) feels overshadowed when their sibling, (sibling), receives public praise.

choices.label: Share the Feeling with a Trusted Friend

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (sibling) notices the effort and thanks them.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (villager) is happy for them but still feels a private sting.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (friend) helps identify a desire for recognition that had gone unspoken.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (villager) discovers satisfaction in a skill of their own.

text_only.reason: "skill" in the everyday sense, not a skill gain -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Their first attempt goes poorly, but curiosity survives.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The request feels awkward, yet it opens a useful conversation.
